description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each), grants [Attach Ice 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking] if entry damage is Ice/Lightning, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Fran] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Fran
description.text: Increases [Ice/Lightning Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Ice or Lightning abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Fran after using a Ice or Lightning ability (max 5), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Shatterheart+
description.text: Four single ranged attacks (1.10 each), causes [Imperil Ice 10% (5s)] and [Imperil Lightning 10% (5s)]

description.name: Feral Mist Strike+
description.text: Six single ranged attacks (1.20 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Fran
description.text: Causes [DEF and RES -50% (8s) Custom Param], grants [Quick Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Attach Ice 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
